   **Pricing and paywall.**

      Review window: Sep 22, 2026 - Sep 23, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Abdur Rauf_, Sep 23, 2026, 1/5: "too much subscription changes don't install if u don't want to pay. without paying it will not work. waste of time and data"
            2. _Hasan Jl_, Sep 22, 2026, 1/5: "All features have now been moved behind a paywall. After six years of utilizing this application, I have decided to discontinue my use, as even basic functionality such as barcode scanning is now restricted to premium subscribers."
            3. _Sam Watson_, Sep 22, 2026, 1/5: "I've used this app for over 10 years at this point and have always recommended it to others. The recent UI change isn't great but I could live with it. What I can't live with is blocking my access to the barcode scanner behind a paywall that I've had no problem using in those 10 years. I will definitely be looking for an alternative now if this is how they feel they need to treat their long time customers."
